purpose: Independent-game generalization test for the deterministic monotone-completion Shapley upper-bound certifier. Vary minimal-support antichains across games rather than reusing one fixed game with new observation seeds.

game_generator.value_rule: binary monotone simple game: v(S)=1 iff S contains at least one generated minimal winning support

support_generator.candidate_sampling: uniform size then uniform subset without replacement
support_generator.antichain_canonicalization: deduplicate candidates, then remove every candidate that strictly contains another candidate; require at least 3 and at most 8 retained supports, otherwise continue deterministic PRNG draws until valid
support_generator.rare_support_injection: before random candidates, inject exactly one support containing target_player plus five uniformly sampled distinct non-target players; antichain canonicalization may remove it if dominated; no post-generation filtering by Shapley value
support_generator.independence_rule: each game uses only its own seed; no reuse of prior game outcomes or supports

truth.method: exact enumeration of all 2^10 coalition values and exact rational Shapley values

observation.method: uniform vertex SRSWOR over the 1024 exact coalition values

certifier.method: same deterministic monotone-completion maximum-weight-closure/min-cut upper bound as coalition_monotone_lp_certifier_v1
certifier.conditional_reporting: for each threshold, report certification rate only over player-game pairs whose exact Shapley truth is <= that threshold; never count truth>threshold pairs as certification failures or successes

scope: Synthetic independent-game holdout only. Results do not authorize lemma-library promotion/demotion or learned-controller changes.
no_posthoc_changes: Do not alter generator, seeds, budgets, thresholds, conditional reporting, or certifier after seeing outcomes. Any implementation repair must be separately versioned and rerun from scratch.
